entities.summary: Mats Ingemar Lindh was a Swedish professional ice hockey player. He played 13 seasons at the top tier of Swedish ice hockey with Mora IK and Västra Frölunda IF, and spent two seasons in North America with the Winnipeg Jets of the World Hockey Association (WHA), winning the Avco World Trophy in 1976. Lindh competed as a member of the Sweden men's national ice hockey team at the 1972 Winter Olympics held in Japan. He also won the World Championship bronze medal twice, playing for Team Sweden, in 1972 in 1975.
